title: Steps this week
hints: Loop over every index from `0` up to (but not including) `count`, and add `steps[i]` to a running total.
Use `size_t` for the index, to match `count`: `for (size_t i = 0; i < count; i++)`. Start the total at `0`, so an empty array naturally gives `0`.
`int total = 0; for (size_t i = 0; i < count; i++) { total += steps[i]; } return total;`
